issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core Questionnaire issue asking for a no-to-all UI mechanism by adding Questionnaire.item.disabledDisplay as a sibling to enableWhen, with hidden and protected values to distinguish hidden disabled items from visible protected disabled items.

Later cleanup and metadata commits adjusted terminology metadata but did not reverse the feature.
additional_context: FHIR-25960 and FHIR-23788 cover related expression and answer-option enablement mechanics, leaving FHIR-25380 focused on disabled-item display behavior. Zulip records the original reporter's hidden-versus-protected no-to-all use case, and Confluence SDC minutes record the issue progressing to Persuasive with Modification. source/fhir.ini keeps Questionnaire active in the current build.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative Questionnaire definition has Questionnaire.item.disabledDisplay as a 0..1 code with required binding to ValueSet/questionnaire-disabled-display, and the associated CodeSystem/ValueSet define hidden and protected.
